source: Local Pelican SQLite bundle, queried read-only with the workspace pelican-scanlogs skill.

vehicle_scope.identification: Sessions selected by matching BMW model VIN pattern and model-year code K. Full VINs and vehicle serial numbers are excluded. Year comes from VIN encoding, not session dates.

limitations: One observed 2019 vehicle cannot establish every engine, firmware or model-year variant.
Positive ISO-TP payload tests establish response identity and framing, not physical meaning or scaling.
Negative replies are NRC 0x31 on this vehicle and route; they do not establish universal non-support.
Only captures with successful AT routing state and matching receive header were attributed. ELM response-count suffixes are excluded from PID identity.
Incomplete multi-frame responses are counted as unmatched and never used as successful fixtures.
Original-definition review flags describe the pre-audit candidates. Extra payload bytes alone do not prove a field width is wrong.
Remaining disabled candidates require independent references or physical/paired-signal measurements before activation.
Historical other-year fixtures support the observed layout. Recomputed physical expectations on those fixtures do not constitute independent calibration on those vehicles.

external_scaling_reference.scope: Independent researcher map, not BMW factory documentation. Supports the 5889 binary fixed-point denominator; its 4408, 4807, 4AB1 and 582F interpretations conflict with this vehicle and are not copied blindly.

rejected_command_policy.other_model_years: debug discovery via dbgfilter; no global dbg override
rejected_command_policy.limitation: Repository configuration is prepared for discovery. The external collection/update service has not been exercised locally.

graduation.rule: Useful decoded quantity, consistent response layout, regression fixture, and corroboration from paired measurements and/or current community definitions and observed range. This is a practical project review, not a published OBDb certification threshold.
graduation.other_years: Retain existing availability filters; use dbgfilter outside 2019. These model years are not newly certified by the local scanlog audit.
graduation.hidden_fields: Uninterpreted TPMS fields and unconfirmed Sport/Manual counter attribution remain hidden research fields, not graduated physical measurements.

remaining_debug_reasons.4683: Input speed factor uncalibrated; observed readings constant zero.
remaining_debug_reasons.4A2E: Constant 6000 does not independently establish rev-limiter identity.
remaining_debug_reasons.558E: Which module owns the distance counter is unresolved.
remaining_debug_reasons.558F: Which module owns the operating-hours counter is unresolved.
remaining_debug_reasons.582F: Temperature estimate and unavailable readings need an independent reference.
remaining_debug_reasons.586F: Pressure field extracted correctly; physical scale unresolved.
remaining_debug_reasons.DA25: Temperature conversion has an unexplained hot-session low outlier.
